blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-derived 2026-07-30 at Ethereum block 25648418: HOME proxy 0xb8919522331c59f5c16bdfaa6a121a6e03a91f62 still points to verified Pool16 implementation 0x366049d336e73cfaf39c6a933780ca4c96ea084c behind ProxyAdmin 0x5729890f78c07bc2d1c09345001f6c1f0c9d7d6f, whose owner() remains the legacy Gnosis MultiSigWallet 0xa42f6fb68607048dde54fcd53d2195cc8ca5f486 (five owners, threshold three). The reviewed current implementation and ABI expose standard transfer/transferFrom behavior but no blacklist, pause, freeze, owner, or admin selector affecting holder transfers. That live 3-of-5 upgrade authority can replace the implementation without a timelock, creating a direct possible future holder-control path. No active holder blacklist or pause is asserted, and no no-freeze conclusion is made.

mintAuthority.summary: HOME token (0xb8919522331c59f5c16bdfaa6a121a6e03a91f62) is an EIP-1967 proxy. The ProxyAdmin (0x5729890f78c07bc2d1c09345001f6c1f0c9d7d6f) is owned by a 5-signer legacy Gnosis MultiSigWallet (0xa42f6fb68607048dde54fcd53d2195cc8ca5f486, threshold 3-of-5). Minting occurs only through Bacon Protocol Pan contracts when borrowers draw lien-backed loans. BACON governance controls Pan additions.

controls.label: Bacon Protocol Pan lending/mint contract
controls.capDescription: HOME supply expands only as new overcollateralized home loans are originated through a Pan; minting is tied to lien-backed loan creation rather than free issuer mint.
controls.evidence: HOME token (0xb8919522331c59f5c16bdfaa6a121a6e03a91f62) is a proxy (EIP-1967 impl slot = 0x366049d336e73cfaf39c6a933780ca4c96ea084c, 24022 bytes); owner() reverts on the proxy — minting is contract-controlled via Pan loan origination. Follow-up 2026-07-20: the HOME token proxy's implementation is the Pool16 lending contract (blockscout-verified): borrow() mints HOME permissionlessly against servicer-issued property NFT liens (99% to borrower, 0.5% to servicer, 0.5% to DAO); getServicerAddress() = 0xa42f6fb68607048dde54fcd53d2195cc8ca5f486 (the reviewed 3-of-5 MultiSigWallet) and the liquidity token is USDC 0xa0b86991... There is no aggregate on-chain supply cap; mint volume is bounded only by servicer-originated loans.

controls.label: HomeCoin ProxyAdmin owner (legacy Gnosis MultiSigWallet)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295203: HOME token EIP-1967 proxy admin slot = 0x5729890f78c07bc2d1c09345001f6c1f0c9d7d6f (ProxyAdmin, verified via Blockscout). ProxyAdmin.owner() = 0xa42f6fb68607048dde54fcd53d2195cc8ca5f486. getOwners() on that address returns 5 EOA addresses; storage slot 4 = 3 (required/threshold); storage slot 3 = 5 (ownerCount). Contract is 342 bytes — classic Gnosis MultiSigWallet (pre-Safe, no module system).
